canonical_template.name: CANONICAL_TEMPLATE_V1
canonical_template.rule: Daily analysis updates values, not structure.
non_deletion_rules: No required section may be removed, renamed, consolidated, or reordered without explicit user approval.
No Section 06 field may be removed when data is unavailable; render the source status instead.
Bullpen — computed and Reliever DB / workload are separate mandatory fields and must never be conflated.
Projected score must label both teams.
Model win % / fair ML must identify the corresponding team.
Preserved pregame states must not be overwritten by live/final retrievals.
Source terminology such as NOT_YET_AVAILABLE, UNRESOLVED, INTELLIGENCE_RESEARCH_REQUIRED, MISSED_PREGAME_CAPTURE and FROZEN_PREGAME must be preserved.

on_every_daily_analysis_request: load current daily manifest and intelligence package
generate DOCX from same populated report model
publish canonical analysis manifest to analysis/current/manifest.json
fetch published files back and verify
publication_contract.failure_rule: If conformance validation fails, do not publish a reduced report.
